channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 15B
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 15B (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15B: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can…
item.description: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can change and belongs in the record's status, not in a permanent name or page address. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: No source change; the status is shown in the record's status field..
item.source: No source change; the status is shown in the record's status field.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15B: The Block 15B page no longer marks UCSF's June 2025…
item.description: The Block 15B page no longer marks UCSF's June 2025 presentation as a plan: the slides list Block 15 as housing under its Long Range Development Plan and also say UCSF has no building plans at Mission Bay. Source: UCSF Mission Bay CAC presentation, 2025-06-12 (sfocii.org).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15B: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15B: Block 15B's notes now say the OCII land use map prints…
item.description: Block 15B's notes now say the OCII land use map prints separate labels for 15A and 15B; that they sit inside one street-bounded block comes from Pier & Point's polygon built from city street centerlines, not from the map. Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019 (sfocii.org ... Att 1 Mission Bay Land Use Map.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15B: Block 15B's notes and milestone said the 2019 land use…
item.description: Block 15B's notes and milestone said the 2019 land use map designates this block for UCSF institutional use; the map only colors it 'UCSF', and UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing, so the use is corrected to residential and the deck is cited for the planned status. The current-parking statement is now labelled our observation in USDA NAIP imagery. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer).
item.source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 15B: UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation… (Jun 12, 2025)
item.description: UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation (meeting date) lists 'Block 15 – Housing' on its slide of 'Undeveloped parcels remaining, and uses per UCSF's Long Range Development Plan'; an earlier slide of the same deck says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now' (Jun 12, 2025). Source: UCSF, posted by the Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2025-06-12.
item.source: UCSF, posted by the Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2025-06-12

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 15B: Same finding as 15A: the Dec 2019 map shows 15B… (Dec 2019)
item.description: Same finding as 15A: the Dec 2019 map shows 15B in the 'UCSF' color (no use type; UCSF's own June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing), and the Dec 2015 property map (LRPMP Attachment B, page 12) shows block 15 as a single undivided block without UCSF color (Dec 2019). Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf.
item.source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 15B: UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File… (~Sep 2016)
item.description: UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File analysed temporary contractor parking on Blocks 15 and 16 (recounted in Addendum #4); a separate September 26, 2016 notice covers wet-utility piping and surface work 'in and adjacent to' Blocks 14, 15, 16 and 18 (~Sep 2016). Source: UCSF Campus Planning / UC Regents, 2017-04-28; Regents of the University of California, via CEQAnet, 2016-09-26.
item.source: UCSF Campus Planning / UC Regents, 2017-04-28; Regents of the University of California, via CEQAnet, 2016-09-26

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 15B: UC Regents certify the 2014 Long Range… (Nov 2014)
item.description: UC Regents certify the 2014 Long Range Development Plan Environmental Impact Report (November 20, 2014) and approve the plan; the report analysed new housing and a relocated child care facility on Block 15 (as recounted in the 2017 addenda). UCSF's documents name the block 'Block 15' without an A/B split (Nov 2014). Source: UCSF Campus Planning / UC Regents, 2017-02-27.
